---------
For the Petitioner(s) : Mr. P.K.Choubey, Advocate For the Opposite Party(s) : Ms. Amrita Kumari,

App
---------
4/Dated: 18th October, 2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2.  The instant bail application has been preferred by the petitioner for grant of regular bail for the offences registered under Sections 366(A) IPC and cognizance has taken under section 366 (A), 371,
376 (3) IPC read with section 4 of POCSO Act.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioner tendered the certified copy of the depositions of P.Ws. 1 and 2,
taken on record.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that during trial the mother of the victim girl has been examined as P.W.1 and the victim herself has been examined as P.W.2 and none of the them have supported the case of the prosecution, as such now it is clear that a false case has been instituted due to confusion by the father of the victim which is evident from para 12 of the deposition of the P.W.2 (victim), as such the petitioner may be enlarged on bail.

5. Learned A.P.P. opposed the prayer for bail, however, could not dispute the fact that in para 12 of the deposition in cross-examination the victim herself deposed that due to suspicion, father of the victim has lodged this case.

1 6.

Having regard to the facts of the case and looking to the deposition of P.W.1 mother and P.W.2 victim herself, it is evident that the victim and the petitioner were friends and on the alleged date of occurrence the victim went to her friend's house and due to some confusion/suspicion the informant has lodged this case and also fact that trial is going on, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.
10,000/- (Ten Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Judicial Commissioner-IV-cum-Special Judge, POCSO, Ranchi, in connection with Airport, P.S. Case No. 07 of 2023, corresponding to Special POCSO Case No. 48 of 2023.
7.

entities.text: Additional Judicial Commissioner-IV-cum-Special Judge, POCSO, Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is made clear that the petitioner shall appear on each and every date before the learned trial court during the trial, failing which learned trial court shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of the petitioner.

(Deepak Roshan, J.) Amardeep/
